title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples and docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Add a set of end-to-end RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) quickstarts and agent/tool-calling examples to the docs site and redwood-examples to help teams bootstrap integrations faster. These examples demonstrate best-practice prompt structure, vector store configuration, prefix/KV cache settings for serving, and tool-calling patterns (external API calls, metadata store interactions). This PR bundles: 1) three RAG quickstarts (python, typescript, and a dockerized on-prem example), 2) two agent tool-calling samples (search + action and multi-tool orchestrator), 3) a set of reusable RAG templates in docs for standard retrieval/prompt chains, and 4) docs site navigation and example gallery updates. Change summary: commits include initial example scaffolding, doc page additions, example tests, small runtime compatibility fixes for streaming responses in the TS sample, and CI/test matrix additions. Checklist: - [x] Add python quickstart with vectorstore + simple Flask-based tool endpoint. - [x] Add TypeScript quickstart using node SDK and example lambda-style tool. - [x] Add dockerized private deployment quickstart demonstrating local vector store and Redwood Private config. - [x] Author RAG templates (prompt + retrieval fallback) as reusable snippets in docs. - [x] Tool-calling agent examples (search+act and orchestrator) with README and run instructions. - [x] Add small E2E smoke tests and example CI job. - [x] Docs site TOC updates and example gallery entry. - [x] Manual QA: run quickstarts and validate streaming + function/tool call traces in Console.
